indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cetuximab 400 mg/m² loading day 1 then 250 mg/m² weekly on days 1,8,15; cisplatin 100 mg/m² day 1; fluorouracil 1000 mg/m²/day days 1–4. Repeat every 21 days for up to six cycles.
treatment.duration_text: Up to six combination cycles every 21 days, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity. After this, weekly cetuximab maintenance may be considered under a separate NCCP 00207 plan.
administration_notes: Antihistamine and corticosteroid at least one hour before every cetuximab infusion; chemotherapy begins at least one hour after cetuximab finishes.

Cetuximab first dose 120 minutes (maximum 5 mg/min), later weekly doses 60 minutes (maximum 10 mg/min). NCCP permits stopping the one-hour observation after two uneventful doses; current EMA SmPC requires close observation for at least one hour after every infusion. Follow the current authorised/local observation plan; do not assume early discharge.
Fluorouracil daily infusion 22 hours; alternative 2000 mg/m² over 46–48 hours repeated for days 3–4,total 4000 mg/m² over 96 hours.

action.message: Confirm the prescribing and consent basis: NCCP wording includes locally advanced disease, while EMA SmPC specifies platinum combination for recurrent/metastatic disease and radiotherapy combination for locally advanced disease. Do not infer a curative combination pathway.

source.document: NCCP 00417 v7 p1 and current EMA Erbitux SmPC 4.1

rules.explanation: Keep NCCP and licensed-indication wording distinct; obtain a context-specific Consultant decision.

eligibility: Locally advanced or metastatic squamous head-and-neck cancer.
ECOG 0–2. Baseline ANC>1.5 ×10⁹/L; platelet entry 100 ×10⁹/L has no comparator in source and requires interpretation.
Baseline creatinine≤1.5×ULN, transaminases≤5×ULN, bilirubin≤1.5×ULN; do not conflate eligibility with treatment-day modifications.
exclusions: Component/excipient hypersensitivity; lactation; complete DPD deficiency.
Pre-existing neuropathy≥grade 2; CrCl<60 mL/min; significant hearing impairment/tinnitus.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest emetogenic active component and phase-specific NCCP classification.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk

baseline: FBC; renal and hepatic profile including magnesium.
DPD phenotype and/or genotype before first fluorouracil unless already tested. Renal impairment may falsely elevate uracil; interpret phenotyping cautiously and consider genotype.
Prior antibody infusion reactions, red meat allergy, tick bites and known anti-cetuximab IgE history.
Audiology and creatinine clearance if clinically indicated.
each_cycle: FBC; renal and hepatic profile including magnesium before each cycle.
Assess cetuximab skin toxicity, infusion history and respiratory symptoms.
Assess hearing/tinnitus and sensory symptoms before each cycle; confirm cisplatin hydration.

Observation-source difference: EMA SmPC requires at least one hour after every cetuximab infusion; NCCP allows discontinuation after two uneventful doses. The current authorised/local plan must resolve this; no automatic early discharge.
after: Electrolytes, magnesium and calcium monthly for two months after the last cetuximab dose.
disease: Imaging and any other tests follow the supervising Consultant plan; no universal routine tumour-marker or scan interval specified.

source_uncertainties: ANC exactly 1.5 overlaps Table 1 full-dose/delay rows; baseline uses>1.5.
Baseline platelet 100 has no printed comparator; Table 1 leaves fractional 99–100 values unassigned.
Fluorouracil bilirubin 85µmol/L and AST 180 U/L exact values are unassigned; hepatic severity categories are not numerically defined.
Severe cytopenia/febrile neutropenia reduction is to be considered with Consultant, not forced.
Skin restart beyond two-week limit or missing history is not automatically authorised.
Cisplatin CrCl 59–60 mL/min fractional gap; baseline<60 exclusion distinct from later 45–59 row.
EMA SmPC observation is at least one hour after every infusion; NCCP allows stopping observation after two uneventful doses.

NCCP indication wording includes locally advanced disease; EMA SmPC specifies platinum combination for recurrent/metastatic disease and radiotherapy combination for locally advanced disease. Confirm the intended setting and prescribing/consent basis.

treatment_phases.label: Combination cycle 1 — cetuximab loading dose
treatment_phases.duration_text: First of up to six combination cycles; stop earlier for disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Cetuximab loading on day 1, then weekly doses on days 8 and 15; platinum on day 1; fluorouracil on days 1–4.

administration.notes: First dose in cycle 1 only: over 120 minutes, maximum 5 mg/min. Weekly cetuximab. Antihistamine and corticosteroid at least one hour before infusion. Later chemotherapy starts at least one hour after the cetuximab infusion ends. NCCP permits ending post-infusion observation after two uneventful doses, whereas current EMA SmPC requires at least one hour after every infusion; follow the agreed current observation plan.

Subsequent weekly doses in cycle 1: over 60 minutes, maximum 10 mg/min. Weekly cetuximab. Antihistamine and corticosteroid at least one hour before infusion. Later chemotherapy starts at least one hour after the cetuximab infusion ends. NCCP permits ending post-infusion observation after two uneventful doses, whereas current EMA SmPC requires at least one hour after every infusion; follow the agreed current observation plan.
1000 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 2 hours; pre- and post-hydration according to the source/local policy. Do not begin before one hour after cetuximab finishes.

Daily schedule: 1000 mg/m²/day over 22 hours on each of days 1–4. Alternative in NCCP: 2000 mg/m² over 46–48 hours across days 1–2, repeated across days 3–4; stated total 4000 mg/m² over 96 hours. Confirm which infusion schedule is prescribed; these are alternatives, not additional doses.

treatment_phases.label: Combination cycles 2–6 — if treatment continues
treatment_phases.duration_text: Continue only as prescribed, to a maximum of six combination cycles in total. Up to six combination cycles every 21 days, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity. After this, weekly cetuximab maintenance may be considered under a separate NCCP 00207 plan.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Weekly cetuximab on days 1, 8 and 15; platinum on day 1; fluorouracil on days 1–4. Maintenance requires a separate prescribed plan.

administration.notes: Subsequent weekly doses: over 60 minutes, maximum 10 mg/min. Do not repeat the 400 mg/m² loading dose automatically. Weekly cetuximab. Antihistamine and corticosteroid at least one hour before infusion. Later chemotherapy starts at least one hour after the cetuximab infusion ends. NCCP permits ending post-infusion observation after two uneventful doses, whereas current EMA SmPC requires at least one hour after every infusion; follow the agreed current observation plan.
1000 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 2 hours; pre- and post-hydration according to the source/local policy. Do not begin before one hour after cetuximab finishes.

Daily schedule: 1000 mg/m²/day over 22 hours on each of days 1–4. Alternative in NCCP: 2000 mg/m² over 46–48 hours across days 1–2, repeated across days 3–4; stated total 4000 mg/m² over 96 hours. Confirm which infusion schedule is prescribed; these are alternatives, not additional doses.
